about_the_game:
A cult has spread to the neighboring kingdom, you were sent to purge it of corruption by the orders of Emperor. Yet soon after arrival you find yourself fallen, unable to go on. But duty still calls, your soul marches on as a spirit. You are to rid this place of darkness, and show no mercy.

Zjawa: Bloodstained Soul is a turn-based souls-like RPG, you will have to carefully think how to use your abilities to defeat your foes, and adapt as they change their tactics. Death is inevitable, but each is but a step towards final victory. For better or for worse.

Features:

  • You play as a spirit, and you can briefly pass through terrain at the cost of your health. Use it to your advantage in exploration and battle.

  • Use variety of items to gain the upper edge in battle.

  • Every death is an opportunity to learn.

  • Face macabre creatures.

  • Kill them all.
